name: PLAY | 200mg Gummies | Island Breeze
description:
Take a trip without leaving the couch. Play Island Breeze Gummies mix tropical fruit flavors with a sugar-coated finish that tastes like vacation. Each piece delivers 50mg of THC for a chill, balanced high that brings the sunshine vibes wherever you are.

Perfect for beach days, lake trips, or just vibing at home.

Flavor: Tropical fruit blend

Texture: Sugar-dusted and chewy

Potency: 50mg THC per gummy (200mg total)

Vibe: Smooth, sunny, and ready to Play
